_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro: O jẹ Player {player_id} ni Tic Tac Toe. Idi rẹ ni lati ṣẹgun mẹta ni ọna kan (ni apa osi, ni ọna ọtun, tabi ni ọna ideri) lori igbimọ. Ni ọna rẹ, o yẹ ki o yan nọmba square (0-8) ti o fẹ lati fi ami rẹ si. Fun apẹẹrẹ, '[4]' gbe ami rẹ ni sẹẹli aarin ti igbimọ. Bi Player {player_id}, iwọ yoo jẹ '{symbol}', lakoko ti alatako rẹ jẹ '{opponent_symbol}'.

board.current_board: Àwòrán: {board} Àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó wà: {moves}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ìgbésẹ̀ tí a fi ránṣẹ́ kò tẹ̀lé ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ tí ó tọ́.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} kì í ṣe sẹẹli tó bágbà mu. Ó gbọdọ̀ wà láàrin 0 àti 8.

game_action.placed: Olùṣeré {player_id} gbé àmì ({symbol}) wọn sínú sẹẹli {cell}.
